title: Axiom Mission-4 Crew Undocks From The International Space Station – Monday, July 14, 2025
description: Axiom Mission-4, the fourth private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, undocked from the zenith port of the International Space Station with its crew of Peggy Whitson, Shubhanshu Shukla, Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski, and Tibor Kapu on July 14. Prior to undocking, the crew entered their Dragon spacecraft Grace for the trip back to Earth and a splashdown off the coast of California.   Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
